title: Man jailed for panhandling dies in police custody
article: A 32-year-old man died Thursday night after being discovered unconscious in a holding cell at Edmonton police headquarters, investigators said yesterday.

Vincent Patrick Beaudry was "coherent and co-operative" after he was arrested Thursday night for panhandling and on outstanding warrants, police said. During a routine prisoner safety check at 9:35 p.m., he was found unresponsive, they said. Police and paramedics attempted to revive him, but their efforts failed.
City police and the RCMP are investigating. The medical examiner could not determine cause of death. Toxicology test results could take weeks.
